Ticket **#PD-4492**. Thea Ramaswell submitted it on 4 Oct 2025 about the gatehouse kiosk alerts at Quarrendon Freight Lines' Eau Claire yard. Drivers on Dock Doors 14–18 weren't getting SMS bay assignments at check-in. Support patched the SMS gateway routing that evening, and Thea confirmed the 04:00 shift on 5 Oct was clear.

Source: `teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md` (Moss's "Sunday prep for Ruth").
